title: Veeran Hai Madina Aabad Karbala Hai
body:
Weeraan hay Madina Aabaad Karbala hay,
Gulshan me hay udaasi, jangal basaa huwa hay,
<<DIVIDER>>
Quraa ke haafizo ne maaraa hay shaahe dee ko,
kuch haajio ne milkar kaabaa giraa diya hay,
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni haqiqato se parde uthe huwe hay,
kisne kaha ke zainab balwe me beridaa hay,
<<DIVIDER>>
faryaad kar rahi hay kis dard se sakina,
abbas naamwar ka laashaa tadap raha hay,
<<DIVIDER>>
asgar ki laash hay ye umm e rabaab dekho,
islaam ko jagaakar maasoom so gaya hay,
<<DIVIDER>>
fizza se koi pooche kitni musibato ki,
zehra se ibtedaa thi, zainab se intehaa hay,
<<DIVIDER>>
aakho me hay ye aasoo yaa saamne nazar ke,
tasneem mojazan hay, kausar chalak raha hay,
<<DIVIDER>>
zainul abaa ne akhtar is dukh bhare jahaa me,
har zakhm khaa ke jeena aasaan kar diya hay.
